lead: A floor check that reads `<crate> test <name> failed` with nothing after it was not judged on a run of that binary.
body: A red run always adds ` -- N test(s) failed: …` or ` -- exit N`; the bare form is the store's verdict, and a `bun nv verify` another agent ends in this tree mid-sweep marks each atom it selected and did not run as owed (`advance` in `tools/nv/select/record.ts`). Before touching the tree, run `cargo test --test <name>` and `bun nv select --explain "test:<crate> test <name>"`, and look in `.agent-tmp/` for a `verify-*.log` newer than the sweep's start.
